quotes.name: Jerald Jensen
quotes.quote: You want to know about 12th Street Station? I'll tell you—when the fog rolls in thick like it did last week, or when there's some big game downtown, I see it in the trash cans. Overflowing. More coffee cups, more wrappers, more people rushing through like the place owes them money. And when the Baylight vote happened? Whole different kind of crowd—folks in suits leaving flyers everywhere, talking loud like they own the benches I just cleaned. Ridership numbers? I don't know numbers. But I know my mop water gets dirtier faster when the city's got something brewing.
